extracted.intended_audience: prospective Stegner applicants and general readers interested in Stanford creative writing
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the Wallace Stegner Fellowship program at Stanford University, its structure, benefits, and basic eligibility/participation requirements for prospective applicants and interested readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program duration and degree outcome
rubrics_metrics.description: The Stegner Fellowship program is a two-year creative writing fellowship at Stanford University. A workshop-based program, no degree is awarded after the two-year fellowship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Originally the fellowship length and relationship to degrees has varied (prior to 1990 many fellows also enrolled in Stanford's now-defunct M.A. program). Emphasizes that participation is for two years and does not result in a formal degree.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number and discipline distribution of fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: Ten fellowships are awarded every year, five in fiction and five in poetry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical expansions are noted (initially three fellows per year; expanded to eight fiction and eight poets in 1973; in 1992 to ten fiction writers and ten poets each year), but current stated allocation is five fiction and five poetry annually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educational credential requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The recipients do not need a degree to receive the fellowships, though many fellows already hold the terminal M.F.A. degree in creative writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly states that holding an MFA (or other degree) is not required for eligibility, but many successful applicants do possess one.

rubrics_metrics.name: Residency/attendance requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows are required to live close enough to Stanford to be able to attend all workshops, as well as other department-related readings and events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Physical proximity and ability to attend in-person workshops and department events is a stated program requirement for fellows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial support and benefits
rubrics_metrics.description: Stegner fellows receive a stipend of $75,000 per year, as well as health insurance and their tuition fee for Stanford.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies stipend amount and that health insurance and tuition are provided; these are program benefits that may affect applicants' ability to accept the fellowship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshop-based instructional model and faculty involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: A workshop-based program with faculty who teach workshops and notable visiting writers serving as guest instructors for quarters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists current and past faculty (poetry and fiction) and notes that other notable writers often serve as guest instructors; indicates the program's pedagogical model centers on workshops led by established writers.
